أبو محمد الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن العباس الرازي التميمي

notes: «سيدي» (honorific of the Imam) and «أبي» before each name are left out; «أبي» + name is one link
The Husayn ibn Ali written twice in succession, each with its own «حدثني أبي», is two links as written (rule 7 counter-example); the archive flags a possible doubled name, not decided here
Ali ibn Abi Talib quotes the Prophet: he is the last link; the Prophet is the end
